title: jamilly-velvety slovakian beef grill
description: A hearty, lacto-vegetarian-friendly breakfast dish from Slovakia featuring minced beef, a tangy whisked egg mixture, and a velvety texture.

ingredients.name: minced beef
ingredients.notes: 80% lean beef, preferably 70-80% fat content for best texture

instructions: Heat a tava-griddle or heavy skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of butter and let it melt.
Add the minced beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter to the skillet and let it melt.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the all-purpose flour and cook for 1 minute, until lightly toasted.
Gradually add the all-purpose milk, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it has thickened, about 2-3 minutes.
Return the cooked beef to the skillet and stir to combine with the egg mixture.
Continue cooking for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the beef is coated in the velvety egg mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
